topics.headline: HY spreads near record tights, but geopolitical risk clouds outlook
topics.summary: At 2.71%, HY OAS sits near multi-decade lows even as CCC spreads have decoupled sharply from BB/B tiers and oil-driven Treasury yield spikes (10yr at 4.66%) signal rising risk; with the Fed likely on hold July 29 and most desks calling for rangebound-to-modestly-wider spreads, a slight widening over 30 days is somewhat more likely than a continued rally, but no acute catalyst points to a sharp move.

topics.headline: Bitcoin ETFs hit seven-day inflow streak, but conviction still shaky
topics.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs just posted their longest inflow streak since October 2025, yet BTC trades below its pivot near $65,900 and analysts (Citi, BRN, Ecoinometrics) say one strong week doesn't confirm institutions are back for good—making net inflows over the next 7 days plausible but far from certain.

topics.headline: VIX complacency at seasonal lows ahead of live FOMC risk
topics.summary: VIX sits near 17, historically its yearly bottoming point, despite Middle East ceasefire collapse, a split Fed, and big-tech earnings all landing within 30 days—recent VIX9D/VIX3M spikes and widening DSPX-VIX spreads suggest the calm may break around the July 28-29 FOMC decision.

topics.headline: Microsoft-Chevron 2.67GW PPA confirms near-certain monthly deal cadence
topics.summary: Microsoft just signed a 20-year, 2GW+ power deal with Chevron's Energy Forge One for its Texas data center campus, continuing an unbroken ~18-month streak of hyperscaler power deals (Meta, Google, Microsoft, Amazon all active) driven by PJM capacity shortfalls and White House pressure to secure dedicated generation, making another such announcement within 30 days highly likely.
